req.title: Login required for delete
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they POST /<id>/delete.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that anonymous users should be redirected to the login page when attempting to delete a post. This behavior ensures that only authenticated users can perform delete operations, maintaining security and data integrity. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct redirection, a negative case to ensure no redirection occurs for authenticated users, and a boundary case to test the behavior when the user is just logged out.

tests.name: test_anonymous_user_redirected_on_delete
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_authenticated_user_no_redirect_on_delete
preconditions: User is logged in as James
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_user_logged_out_redirect_on_delete
preconditions: User logs in and then logs out
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
client.get('/auth/logout')
r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'
